name: Victorian Web
summary: Dense ornament, engraved borders, high-contrast serif type, deep jewel colours, gold, dark wood and old paper. It recalls the 19th century and gives a page a proud, collected and gothic mood.

philosophy.core_thesis: Ornament is value: every surface carries pattern, rule and flourish.
design_principles: Frame every page with a double border: 1px and 3px lines with a gap of 3px to 4px in a dark ink or gold.
Use ornamental corners and dividers (a flourish or a fleuron) of 24px to 64px at each section break.
Set headings in a high-contrast serif (Didone or old style) at 48px to 96px with upper case or small caps; body at 17px to 19px with a leading of 1.6.
Build the palette from deep jewel tones (burgundy, bottle green, navy) with gold (#B8860B) as accent on a parchment (#F1E5C8) or a dark ground.
Fill backgrounds with damask or wallpaper patterns at 6% to 12% opacity and a repeat of 80px to 160px.
Use drop caps of 3 to 4 lines on the first paragraph and a gold or red initial.
Add engraving-style illustrations with hatching lines of 0.5px to 1px; no flat vector.
anti_patterns: Large empty space with a single focus

layout.grid_mechanics: A centred column in a double-ruled frame of 960px to 1100px; sections are divided by ornaments; a sidebar of 240px holds a catalogue list.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 5% to 15% of the surface is empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 24, 40 and 64px.
layout.alignment_rules: Centred headings and ornaments; justified body text; captions in italic below images.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangles and arches with cut or scalloped corners of 8px to 16px; ovals for portraits; double borders.

font_pairings.note: A Didone display with high contrast.
An old-style face with an engraved look.
A blackletter for short titles and initials.

hierarchy_rules: Use weights 400 and 700 for display and 400 for body.
Set headings in upper case or small caps.
Set drop caps at 3 to 4 lines.

color.palette_structure: Jewel tones on parchment, with gold and black.
color.contrast_rules: Ebony on parchment holds 13:1; gold carries ornament and borders only, never small text.
color.surface_treatment: Flat parchment with paper grain at 4% to 8% and damask patterns at 6% to 12%.
color.light_and_shadow: Low, warm and papery; a shadow of 0 2px 6px at 20% under a framed block.

materiality.surface_simulation: Engraved paper, gilt, velvet and dark wood.
materiality.border_rules: A double border: 1px and 3px lines with a gap of 3px in gold or ink.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Almost no blur; a soft inner vignette of 40px at 10% on the ground.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Engraved 1.5px icons with fine serifs, or fleurons and manicules instead of icons.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Engravings, cameos, floral borders, damask and portraits in ovals.

motion.transition_physics: Stately: fades of 400ms to 600ms; borders draw in; no bounce.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover turns a link burgundy and adds a gold underline of 2px; active state darkens it by 10%.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels they are inside a proud, collected and slightly haunted house.

avoid_when: The product needs a fast, clean tool UI.
The audience expects a minimal look.
The page must load on weak devices with large patterns.

modifiers.how: Replace fixed borders with a flowing line and use 2 colours.
Keep the serif and rules; remove ornament and use a white ground.
Cut the engravings and set them in black and white with torn edges.

pack.why: A thin, fine line family that pairs with fleuron ornaments.

ground.why: Victorian print put each page inside ruled borders, and the double rule in two inks is that frame.
